title: Geodesic Causal Forests: Learning Heterogeneous Treatment Effects for Random Objects
abstract: arXiv:2611.33350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal forests and orthogonal learners estimate heterogeneous treatment effects for scalar or Euclidean outcomes, yet outcomes are increasingly random objects, such as compositions, covariance matrices, distributions, or networks, in metric spaces without linear structure. We introduce geodesic causal forests for conditional geodesic treatment effects. Geodesic transport moves each geodesic between conditional Fr\'echet means of the potential outcomes to a common reference, making effects comparable across individuals. Because random objects cannot be added or subtracted, Euclidean residual corrections are unavailable; we instead correct the squared-distance loss through which the forest selects splits and estimates effects. The loss is real-valued for every candidate effect, so the correction requires only Fr\'echet means and leaves second-order nuisance error; for Euclidean outcomes, it recovers doubly robust learning. translated_title: 测地因果森林：学习随机对象的异质性处理效应
translated_abstract: 因果森林和正交学习器用于估计标量或欧几里得结果的异质性处理效应，然而结果越来越常见地是随机对象，例如成分数据、协方差矩阵、分布或网络，它们存在于缺乏线性结构的度量空间中。我们提出了用于条件测地处理效应的测地因果森林。测地传输将潜在结果的条件Fréchet均值之间的每条测地线移动到一个公共参考点，使效应在个体之间具有可比性。由于随机对象无法进行加减运算，欧几里得式的残差校正方法不再可用；我们转而对森林用于选择分裂和估计效应的平方距离损失进行校正。该损失对每个候选效应都是实值的，因此校正只需要Fréchet均值，并将干扰参数误差保留在二阶；对于欧几里得结果，该方法可恢复双重稳健学习。
tldr: 提出测地因果森林，通过校正平方距离损失而非残差，在无线性结构的度量空间中估计随机对象（如分布、协方差矩阵、网络）的异质性处理效应，并在欧几里得情形下恢复双重稳健学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes geodesic causal forests that estimate heterogeneous treatment effects for random objects (distributions, covariance matrices, networks) in metric spaces without linear structure by correcting the squared-distance loss instead of residuals, recovering doubly robust learning for Euclidean outcomes.
